name: exact
description: Write an app once. It runs natively on the web, macOS, iOS, and Linux, and an AI agent can build it, run it, see it, and test it on every one of them.

issues.title: Push notifications from a server, including in an app that has Live Activities
Linux / Raspberry Pi 4: Ink rendering performance investigation and improvements
Windows: an app cannot run without its window (no keepRunning, no windowless launch, a login item's hidden is not honoured)
A Rust data source cannot turn a 2D canvas recording into pixels (no toBlob or getImageData)
Support audio that plays through the silent switch while mixing with other apps
Android: Hermes has no Intl, and one top-level use silently stops the data module from loading
Android: a module view gets taps only, so a hosted map cannot be panned or zoomed
Windows: private bytes reach about 650 MB with two large 2D canvases, one resized by a drag (measurement)
